subject.title: feat: add the query card block

question: Should Dinkus Blocks admit `dinkus.query-card` as a supported public block during the dogfood period?
rationale: The PR adds a durable public plugin and stored-content surface; repository policy reserves merge authority to the project owner, and no maintainer approval is present in the discussion.

options.title: Approve the bounded query card
options.body: Admit only the implemented one-source, one-limit card and retain the explicit exclusions for filters, pagination, commerce fields, and further query blocks.

options.title: Defer query blocks
options.body: Keep the small block vocabulary unchanged until the foundation dogfood milestone establishes a need for runtime collection queries.

recommendation.title: Approve the bounded query card
recommendation.body: Admit only the implemented one-source, one-limit card and retain the explicit exclusions for filters, pagination, commerce fields, and further query blocks.
